# clio backup prune

Delete all but the newest N snapshots by manifest time: the newest snapshot is never deleted, an unreadable archive is reported and kept, and without --confirm nothing is removed. Exit codes: 0 report-only or complete prune, 3 confirmed prune could not remove every candidate

## Usage

```
clio backup prune --keep N [--confirm] [--dry-run] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

keeps the newest N snapshots by manifest time and deletes the rest; the newest snapshot is never a candidate and --keep 0 is refused. An archive whose manifest cannot be read is reported as unreadable and never deleted, and a symlinked archive is reported and skipped, never followed. Without --confirm (or with --dry-run) nothing is removed and the run is a report that exits 0. Exit codes: 0 report or complete prune, 2 usage refusal, 3 a confirmed prune that could not remove every candidate

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--keep N` | uint |  | Counts the newest snapshots `backup_prune_cli::required_keep` keeps; it refuses `0` and a value that is not a count. |
| `--confirm` |  |  | Tells `backup_prune_cli::removes` to delete the selected candidates; absent, the run reports and removes nothing. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Forces the report path in `backup_prune_cli::removes` even with `--confirm`, so nothing is removed. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Report which snapshots a prune would delete.
```
clio backup prune --keep 3
```

Delete all but the newest three.
```
clio backup prune --keep 3 --confirm
```

Report as JSON and remove nothing.
```
clio backup prune --keep 3 --dry-run -o json
```
